tei:div.tei:p: 373) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rje btsun 'phags ma'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs dpal ster bzhugs so: 374) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye:

rgyal kun phrin las gcig 'dus dpal: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma yi: sgrub pa nyams su len pa'i thabs: byin rlabs dpal ster 'di ru bkod: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: dben snying nyams dga'i gnas mchog tu: dkyil 'khor bkod legs me tog bkram: dbus su sgrub pa'i gtor ma dang: bla rdo srog 'khor nyer spyod sogs: mkho ba'i yo byad legs par bshams: phyi nang mi yi rgyu 'grul spangs: dkar dmar gtor skyus mchod sbyin bya: de yis bgegs zhi dngos grub myur: de nas 'jug pa'i rim pa la: dang po tshogs zhing gsal ba ni: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta= sogs: 375) rang mdun nam mkhar pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang: dbyer med rgyal kun phrin las gcig 'dus pa: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma myur dpa' mor: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med dang: rtsa gsum zhi khro rab 'byams ma lus pa: dkyil dang 'khor lo'i rnam par yongs shar ba: mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung gtibs bzhin gsal: thugs rjes brtse bas dgongs te bzhugs par bsam: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ ces brjod mdun mkhar skyabs yul lha tshogs gsal: sgo gsum dad pas skyabs su 'gro ba 376) ni: na mo: rgyal ba kun yum 'phags ma sgrol: bdag sogs 'di nas byang chub bar: sgo gsum dad pas skyabs su mchi: 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol: lan gsum brjod mthar sems bskyed ni: hoḥ ma gyur mkha' mnyam sems can kun: rnam grol sa la 'god pa'i phyir: smon dang 'jug pa byang chub sems: dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi: lan gsum dang yan bdun ni: na moḥ rgyal yum 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor la: sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul: mi dge'i las nyon sgrib pa bshags: dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rangs: theg gsum chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: rgyal kun mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs:

dge rtsa 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: bla med byang chub sa thob shog: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim nas gnyis su med par grol bar bsam: de nas bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ nga ni dpal chen he ru ka: log 'dren 'byung po 'dul ba'i gshed: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: 'dod yon gtor ma 'di longs la: gsang ba'i gnas 'dir ma 'dug 377)par: da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ ham̐'u u tsa ta ya phaṭa: ces brjod thun gyis brab cing drag sngags bzla: bgegs rnams yul med chen por bskrad: de nas srung 'khor sgom pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: 'od zer thun mtshon pho nya spros: gnod byed ma lus phyir bskrad nas: gzhom gzhig bral ba rdo rje'i gur: ye shes chen por lhun gyis grub: dharma dhartu badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūm̐ swā hā: de nas byin chen dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min zhing dang g.yu lo bkod: dag pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas: rgyal yum ār+ya tā re ma: rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa kunaḥ thugs rje tshad med mkhyen dang brtses: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phobs: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang bar chad ma lus sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ a be sha ya a āḥ de nas mchod rdzas brlab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang srid dpal yon thams cad kun: mchod pa'i rdzas mchog bla na med: ting 'dzin 378)yid kyis rab sprul nas: nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor spel: ma hā sarba pañca pū dza āḥhūm̐: de nas dngos gzhi lha bskyed ni: oṃ bh+rūm̐ tām̐ḥ snang ba thams cad yum lnga'i klong: srid pa mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing: rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas khang: tshad dang mtshan nyid rab rdzogs dbus: yan lag brgyad ldan mtsho dkyil du: chu skyes ge sar bzhad pa'i steng: tām̐ yig ljang gu yongs gyur las:

rang nyid rje btsun myur dpa' mo: margad mdog can zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis g.yas pas mchog sbyin mdzad: phyag g.yon ut+pal yu ba ni: mtheb srin gyis bzung rnyan thad rgyas: ze'u 'brur zla steng tshe yi lha: yid bzhin 'khor lo dkar gsal mdzes: phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon tshe bum: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil stabs su bzhugs: myur dpal lha mo zhi 'dzum mdzes: zhabs gnyis g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums kyis: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs: bcu drug gzhon nu'i tshul ldan zhing: nu 'bur mnyen lcug zhi tshul ldan: rin chen sna tshogs 379)mgul rgyan dang: snyan rgyan phyag gdub do shal dang: dpung rgyan la sogs rgyan chas gsol: dbu skra gyen bcings lhag ma zar bu grol: dbu gtsug rigs bdag snang mtha' mnyam gzhag mdzad: ye shes 'od lnga 'khyil ba'i klong du bzhugs: dar sna lnga yi stod g.yogs tshar bu 'phyang: dar dmar smad dkris ye shes 'ja' 'od klong: snang la rang bzhin med pa chen por bsgom: de mthar sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig dang: sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam mkha' 'gro dang: dpa' bo dpa' mo chos skyong rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen por lam mer gsal: de ltar gsal ba'i rje btsun myur dpa' mo'i: spyi bor oṃ dkar mgrin par āḥdamar po: thugs kar hūm̐ mthing de las 'od zer ni: dkar dmar mthing gsum rnam par phyogs bcur 'phros: dbyings bzhugs bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kun: rje btsun 'phags ma'i rnam par byon nas kyang: mtsho la char babs bzhin du bskyed pa'i lhar: dbyer med ro gcig dam tshig rten dang bsres: de nas spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hūm̐: bde chen zhing dang po ta la: g.yu lo bkod dang pad+ma 'od: 380)rang bzhin rnam dag zhing khams nas: rje btsun ār+ya tā re ma: sgrol ma nyer gcig 'khor dang bcas: gang 'dul mdzad pa phrin las kyis: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:

sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du rlobs: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ ār+ya tā re badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes brjod mdun gyi nam mkha' la: rje btsun 'phags ma gtso 'khor dang: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams: mtsho la gza' skar shar ba bzhin: mdun mkhar sprin phung 'thib bzhin du: bzhugs par dmigs la 'di skad brjod: sgo gsum rnam par dag pa'i ngang: oṃ: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma dang: phyogasabacu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas: rtsa gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang: nyer gcig 'phags ma'i lha tshogs la: bdag sogs gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: dngos yid ting 'dzin rab sprul mchod pa'i tshogs: rje btsun 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bdag gzhan dus gsum kun nas las bsags pa'i: mi dge'i nyes tshogs thams cad mthol zhing bshags: zag bcas zag med dge tshogs ci mchis par: kun nas kun tu rjes su yi rang 381)ngo: gang 'dul thabs dang thugs rje tshad med pas: theg gsum yang dag bla med chos 'khor bskul: ji srid gnas ngan 'khor ba ma stongs bar: de srid rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs: dus gsum bsags dang bsag 'gyur dge rtsa kun: mkha' mnyam 'gro ba yongs la dmigs te bsngo: ma lus 'gro rnams srid pa'i mtsho brgal nas: yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa thob shog: ces brjod: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rgyal kun yon tan gter 'dzin ma: rje btsun 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams: bdag cag 'gro ba'i dpal du yang: sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: dam tshig pa dang gnyis med du: chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin du: dam ye dbyer med ro gcig gyur: badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i yum gcig ma: ye shes yon tan kun gyi mdzod: mgon med 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu: rgyal yum ār+ya tā re ma: rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la:

rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: na mo na ma hoḥ de nas 382) mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang srid dpal yon thams cad kun: mchod pa'i rdzas mchog bla na med: ting 'dzin yid sprul lha mo ni: me tog ma dang bdug spos ma: snang gsal ma dang dri chab ma: ro yi lha mo zhal zas thogs: rol mo dbyangs snyan mchod pa'i rigs: bsam mi khyab par rab sprul nas: kun bzang mchod sprin lta bu ru: rgyal yum 'phags ma'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ ār+ya tā re maṇ+ḍa la sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs: shap+da sarba pū dza sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa ye swā hā: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ snying rje'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa pad dkar 'chang: thugs rje byin rlabs ye shes sgyu ma'i gar: 'jigs kun las skyob ār+ya tā re ma: rgyal ba sras dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas rang gnong bshags pa ni: hoḥ rgyal yum 'phags ma'i lha tshogs dgongs: bdag cag ma rig 'khrul dbang gis: sdom gsum dang 'gal mthol lo bshags: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra satwa= sogs: āḥ de nas 'dzab dmigs ni: 383)hūm̐: rang nyid 'phags ma'i thugs klong du: gser 'khor rtsibs brgyad lte ba ru: pad zla'i steng du thugs srog tām̐: ljang gsal 'od dang 'od zer 'phros: rgyal kun mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus: 'gro ba'i las nyon sgrib pa sbyangs: thams cad bde la 'god par bsam: snang ba lha la sgra grags sngags: dran rtog 'od gsal chos sku'i thugs: khyer so gsum ldan ngang nas bzla: oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā: ces pa mi tshig ma 'dres par: bye pa bzlas pas 'phags ma yis: rjes bzung byin gyis rlob par 'gyur: sgrub dang las sbyor dmigs pas dbye: rim gnyis 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur: sa ma ya: rjes rim 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor du: bsod nams tshogs chen bsog pa'i thabs: longs spyod bza' bca' btung pa'i rigs:

ci 'byor bsags shing bshams byas te: rang nyid lha yi ting 'dzin gyis: byin gyis brlab pa 'di skad do: oṃ: snang ba'i dngos po ma lus kun: āḥ zag med ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: hūm̐: 'dod yon longs spyod mchod pa'i sprin: rgyal kun mnyes pa'i rdzas su spel: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum dang: 384) nam mdzod sngags lan gsum brjod: de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang snang dag pa 'og min gnasaḥ mkha' spyod g.yu lo bkod pa nas: rgyal kun thugs rje gcig bsdus dpal: rje btsun ār+ya tā re ma: sgrol ma nyer gcig 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams na: bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas: byang sems 'phags pa'i lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs: gdan gsum 'khor lo'i gzhal yas nas: yi dam zhi chags khro bo'i gar: gnas yul zhing skyong dpa' bo dang: mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro ma: dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: tshogs kyi mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs: byin rlabs 'od phung lams se lam: dngos grub sbrang char nyi li li: thig le sku ru shigs se shig: dri zhim ngad pa thu lu lu: sgra dang rol mo 'u ru ru: dpa' bos bro rdung khre+igs se khrig: dpa' mos glu len kyu ru ru: rig 'dzin gar stabs shigs se shig: rdo rje'i glu gar tshogs la gshegs: sgrub mchog sgo gsum 385)rdo rjer smin: mchog thun su kha'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ ār+ya tā re gu ru dhe wa dhā ki ni badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ de nas bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rang byung ye shes byang chub sems: gnyis med mnyam pa'i sprin chen po: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes phyir 'bul: zhen med bde chen ngang du rol: ma hā sarba pañca pū dza la khā hiḥ de nas tshogs phud ni: oṃ: ye shes lnga las rang byung ba'i:

zag med bdud rtsi longs spyod tshogs: rig stong dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: mnyam nyid bde stong chen por bzhes: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra la khā hiḥ de nas thugs dam bskang ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos su bshams dang yid las sprul: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog dang: bdug spos dmar me dri chab sogs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs: kun tu bzang po'i rnam rol du: sprul te rab gus dad pas mchod: rje btsun 'phags ma'i thugs dam bskang: nyer gcig lha mo'i thugs= rgyal ba sras bcas thugs= rtsa gsum dam can= thugs dam bskangs la nyams chag 386)bshags: lta ba mtha' bral dbyings su bskang: sgom pa blo 'das rig pas bskang: spyod pa kun tu bzang po'i klong: thams cad dag mnyam chen por bskang: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: de nas bar bshags ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig sgrib dbang gis: so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi: sdom dang bslab pa dam nyams pa: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags: dag cing tshangs par mdzad du gsol: zhes yi ge brgya pa brjod: de nas lhag ma ni: a kā ro yis sbyangs spel nas: pheṃ: lhag la dbang ba'i lhag skyong rnams: 'dir gshegs 'dod yon tshogs lhag rol: sngon tshe dpal chen bka' dam bzhin: las bzhi'i phrin las yongs 'grub mdzod: sa ma ya u tsiṣ+ṭa bha liṃ ta khā hi: de nas thugs dam bskul pa ni: hūm̐: bzhegs shig 'phags ma dbyings nas bzhengs: bskul lo thugs dam gnad nas bskul: mdzod cig bdag cag dpung gnyen mdzod: byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad sol: 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug bzlog: bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe srings: mdo 387)sngags chos kyi gzhi tshugs la: rgyal bstan yun brtan phrin las mdzod: thugs dam ma g.yel sa ma ya: de nas chad don tho'i ma gtong ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe spyi dpal he ru ka'i: spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i:

dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud tshogs: 'dir gshegs chad tho'i gtor ma longs: sgrub pa'i bar chad rkyen sol la: phrin las rab 'byams myur 'grub mdzod: dam las la 'da' sa ma ya: ci bcol las kun 'grub par mdzod: de nas bstan ma ni: bh+yo: rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng giḥ bka' dang dam la gnas pa yi: bod skyong bstan ma ya ma'i tshogs: 'khor dang bcas pa 'dir gshegs la: bshal chu'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bod khams bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: ma bh+yo dza hriṃ bha liṃ ta khā hi: de nas rta bro ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ gru gsum e yi khang sgrom du: gnyis 'dzin ma rig ru tra mnan: sku gsum ye shes chen po'i bros: nam yang ldang med phyag rgyas mnan: oṃ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: hūm̐ laṃ: swā laṃ: hā laṃ: s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: mā ra ya nan: 388) de nas mchod cing bstod la dngos grub ni: hoḥ rje btsun 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi: sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i lha tshogs kyi: gsang gsum chos nyid klong mdzod nas: rdo rje gsum gyi dbang dngos grub: sgrub mchog sgo gsum bum par bskyil: 'jigs brgyad zhi dang tshe bsod rgyas: khams gsum dbang sdud rab 'byams kyi: las kun 'grub pa'i dbang dngos grub: da lta nyid du thob par shog: rtsa sngags: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi hrī:

de bas bshags pa ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spyan snga ru: bdag cag sgo gsum bag med pas: bskyed bzlas ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang: gsang sngags gzhung bzhin ma spyad pa'i: 'gal 'khrul ci mchis bzod par gsol: dag tshangs mchog thun dngos grub stsol: man ngag yig brgya lan gsum brjod: de nas bsdu ldang ni: hūm̐: thabs kyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: rim bsdus 'od gsal chos sku'i klong: skye med stong pa'i ngang du āḥ slar yang rjes thob sgyu ma'i sku: rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs pa'i lha: chu zla ji bzhin lam mer bsgom: rtsa sngags mthar: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: de nas bsngo ba ni: 389)hoḥ rgyal yum 'phags ma'i dkyil 'khor du: bsod nams dge rtsa ci bsags pa: mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kun: rnam grol sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo: lan gsum dang smon lam ni: hoḥ skye dang tshe rabs thams cad du: rje btsun ma khyed lhag pa'i lhar: 'bral med rtag tu spyod nas kyang: bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su: bdag gzhan 'gro rnams yongs grol shog: de nas bkra shis ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang: gsang sngags zab mo'i rten 'brel mthus: bdag cag sgrub mchog 'khor bcas la: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i bkra shis shog: tshe bsod rgyas pa'i= mos bzhi dbang sdud= dgra bgegs tshar gcod= chos bzhin spyod pa'i bkra shis shog: ces dang bkra shis ci rigs brjod: las rjes mi mngon gsang ba gnad: rab dngos 'bring nyams tha na yang: rmi lam sogs la 'grub pa'i rtags: mngon du gyur par the tshom med: lag tu longs dang gsal bar nges: sa ma ya: e ma:yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud zab mo 'di: kho mo rdo rje mtsho yi thugs dam mthil: pad+ma saṃ bhas gces nor tshul du gdams: shin tu myur zab lam mchog 'di nyid ni: phyi rabs rjes 'jug gdul bya skyob pa' ི 390) phyir: mi 'gyur zab mo brda yi ris su thob:

ma 'ongs snyigs ma nyi shu kha ral dus: mtsho rgyal sprul pa las 'phro can dang 'phrad: brda bsgyur dpe byed rnam mang 'gro ba skyob: 'brel tshad bde chen g.yu lo bkod du skye: the tshom med do phyi rabs rjes 'jug rnams: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam yod: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung lha mo dpal ldan ma la bcol: thub par srungs shig gnyer gyis sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang dge btsun bho dha dang*/ rigs ldan sngags kyi btsun ma nyi ma sgron mas rin chen in+d+ra'i mdangs 'dzin dang rdo rje sems dpa'i me long*/ sman sna sogs kyi skyes bcas dus ring mo nas nan cher yang yang bskul ngor/ khams 'dus kyi rkyen gyis brda khrol shin tu dka' yang*/ mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig la bsam nas snyoms las ba bde ba'i rdo rjes brtson 'grus kyi mthus bskul nas bris pa dge'o//
